name: inspira-animated-testimonials
title: Animated Testimonials
description: One customer testimonial at a time: a stack of slightly rotated portrait photos on the left, and on the right a name, job title, quote and two round arrow buttons that cycle to the next person.
use: A landing page should show one strong customer quote with a portrait and simple forward and back arrows.
avoid: Autoplay advances every four seconds, which is short for reading a full paragraph.
a11y: Both arrows are real buttons with aria-labels and photos carry alt text, but nothing checks reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a dark panel, a square portrait sits at a slight angle with two faint copies fanned behind it. To the right, a bold name, a small grey role line, a few lines of quote text, and two small circular arrow buttons at the lower left of that column.
behaves: Pressing an arrow swaps the photo with a small lift and settles the new portrait upright, while the quote disappears and its words blur back in one after another. With autoplay on it advances on a timer.
customise: Feed entries with quote, name, designation and image; autoplay and duration set the cycling, while the photo rotations and layout are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Three portrait images and one active slide with short blur and lift animations.
